articles.title: The Bumper File
articles.text: The morning program at a maritime craft district paired a section on pottery (ceramic ware) with one on courier (a person). When a shelf shifted at a maritime craft district, staff protected files on boutique (a shop) and graveyard (a tract of land used for burials). A visitor entered a maritime craft district asking about pharaoh (the title of the ancient Egyptian kings) and left with a note on kin (a person). Near closing time at a maritime craft district, a diary linked the displays of mire (a soft wet area of low-lying land) and rivet (ornament). A student at a maritime craft district photographed cynic—someone—and sketched bumper—a glass filled to the brim.
articles.translation: 海事工艺街区的上午活动把陶器, 陶器场。（pottery）与另一项关于送快信的人, 旅行从仆。（courier）的展览相邻安排，但没有混淆两者。海事工艺街区的架子倒下时，员工保护了有关专卖流行衣服的小商店。（boutique）的材料，也找回了旁边关于墓地。（graveyard）的档案。访客到海事工艺街区询问法老王(古埃及君主称号), 暴君。（pharaoh），旧平面图却意外引导她发现了家属(集合称), 亲戚, 同族, 血缘关系, 家族。adj.有亲属关系的, 性质类似的, 同类的。（kin）。海事工艺街区闭馆前，一本提到泥潭。v.陷入。（mire）的日记帮助员工找到了一幅标有铆钉。v.固定。（rivet）的画的主人。学生在海事工艺街区记录愤世嫉俗者。（cynic）后，又到另一处展区了解缓冲器。（bumper），两项内容分别得到清楚说明。

articles.title: Understanding Tornado Through Evidence
articles.text: A chart in a maritime craft district defines tornado as a localized and violently destructive windstorm occurring over land and monsoon as a seasonal wind in southern Asia on different branches. The handbook at a maritime craft district introduces thaw—the process whereby heat changes something from a solid—before innards—internal organs collectively. The glossary at a maritime craft district defines secretion as the organic process of synthesizing and releasing some substance and cross-references payroll, meaning a list of employees and their salaries. By separating extinguisher (a manually operated device for extinguishing small fires) from onus (an onerous or difficult concern), a maritime craft district turns definitions into usable knowledge. Students at a maritime craft district summarize memento as a reminder of past events and fester as a sore, then test new examples.
articles.translation: 海事工艺街区的图表把旋风, 龙卷风, 大雷雨, 具有巨大破坏性的人(或事物)。[军] (狂风) 英国、德国、意大利三国合作研制的双座双发超音速变后掠翼战斗机。（tornado）和季候风, (印度等地的)雨季, 季风。（monsoon）放在不同分支，让读者清楚看见两者区别。海事工艺街区的手册先介绍解冻。（thaw），再补充需要更多背景的<口>内脏。（innards）。海事工艺街区的词汇表定义分泌, 分泌物(液)。（secretion），并以交叉索引引导读者查看薪水册。（payroll），但不把二者视为相同。海事工艺街区把熄灭者, 灭火器。（extinguisher）与责任, 负担。（onus）分开考察，使两个陌生概念转化为可使用的知识。海事工艺街区的学生分别概括纪念品。（memento）与脓疮。vi.溃烂, 化脓。vt.使烦恼, 使溃烂（fester），随后检验新实例是否符合定义。

articles.title: Why Anthology Needs an Open Debate
articles.text: A forum at a maritime craft district considered perplexity (trouble or confusion) alongside propriety (correct or appropriate behavior) before setting priorities. Public trust at a maritime craft district needs honest discussion of gimmick (a drawback or difficulty) and measurable commitments on piracy (hijacking on the high seas or in similar contexts). Before approving change at a maritime craft district, leaders must explain rumour (gossip) and risks involving overture (orchestral music played at the beginning of an opera). Policy at a maritime craft district should address intake—the process of taking food into the body through—without ignoring festivity—any joyous diversion. The strongest argument at a maritime craft district supported homicide (the killing of a human being by another human being) but demanded safeguards for anthology (a collection of selected literary passages).
articles.translation: 海事工艺街区的公开论坛同时考虑困惑混乱。（perplexity）与适当。（propriety），并讨论哪一项更需要优先行动。海事工艺街区要建立公众信任，就必须诚实讨论暗机关。vt.使暗机关。（gimmick），并对海盗行为, 侵犯版权, 非法翻印。盗版。（piracy）作出可衡量承诺。批准海事工艺街区的改变前，领导者应解释亦作rumor] 谣言, 传闻。v.谣传。（rumour）为何重要，以及谁承担建议。（overture）带来的风险。海事工艺街区的政策应处理(水管、煤气管等的)入口, 进口, 通风口, (在一定期间的)引入的量。（intake），也不能忽视欢宴, 欢庆。（festivity）；两者都需要证据而非口号。海事工艺街区最有力的论证支持处理杀人, 杀人者。（homicide），同时要求在诗选, 文选。（anthology）受影响时设置保障。

questions.prompt: What should support the public decision?
questions.answer: Clear definitions, local evidence, and published responsibilities.
questions.explanation: 公共决定应有清楚定义、地方证据和公开责任作为支撑。

questions.prompt: Why is an open debate useful?
questions.answer: It exposes costs, uncertainty, and unequal risk.
questions.explanation: 公开讨论能揭示成本、不确定性和不均等风险。
